title: Run of the borrow pass
statement: Let $W$ be a finite binary machine, $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a schedule-symbol input. Take a configuration whose budget tape has head at integer position $z$, whose contents are the bit symbols for a word $bs$ beginning at that position followed by a right-hand list $r$, and whose state is the borrow phase with carry $c$. After exactly $|bs|$ steps, the machine is in the borrow phase with the carry produced by processing $bs$ from initial carry $c$; its budget-tape head is at $z+|bs|$, and the tape contains the reversed list of rewritten bits to the left of that position followed by $r$. The resulting configuration agrees with the original base configuration on every other component and tape.
hypotheses_covered: A base configuration for the schedule machine on $x$
Finite lists $l,r$ of optional schedule symbols defining the budget-tape contents
replaced:
Let $W$ be a binary machine, $a$ a padding constant, and let a bit word $w$ be laid
out as bit symbols on the budget lane of the schedule controller, starting in the
borrow phase with carry $c$.  Running the controller for exactly $|w|$ steps carries
out the fixed-width borrow pass on $w$: the phase becomes borrow with the resulting
borrow flag, the rewritten word is moved in reverse into the processed zone, the head
has advanced by $|w|$, and every other tape content and head position, including
copied input data in later decorations, is unchanged.
